tagline: Transforming the ways in which people can protect everything that matters to them
hero_kpi_rationale: Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) is Arlo's primary growth driver, reflecting the adoption of its cloud services and secure subscriptions at the core of its transformation into a smart security SaaS platform.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Expected annual revenue from paid subscriptions, a key indicator of future growth.
kpis.description: ARR measures Arlo's ability to convert users into paying customers through its secure subscription services.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in the recurring model, signaling customer retention and monetization.

kpis.name: Subscriptions and Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from Arlo's subscription and cloud services.
kpis.description: In 2025, service revenue represents 59.8% of total revenue, up from 47.6% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Services now exceed products in relative weight.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue combining products and services.
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by 3.6% in 2025, driven by services despite declining product sales.
kpis.signal: Modest but positive growth following a difficult year.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, after cost of goods sold (COGS).
kpis.description: Gross margin improved from 36.7% in 2024 to 44.0% in 2025, driven by a shift toward higher-margin subscriptions.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement due to the growing contribution of higher-margin services.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit or loss divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin turned positive in 2025 (1.2%) compared to -6.8% in 2024, driven by service growth and cost reductions.
kpis.signal: Return to operational breakeven after a loss in 2024.

kpis.name: R&D (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Arlo maintains a high level of R&D investment to develop its smart products and AI capabilities.
kpis.signal: Stable investment in innovation, despite a slight relative decline.

kpis.name: Cumulative Paid Accounts
kpis.explanation: Total number of accounts with an active subscription.
kpis.description: Paid accounts increased from 4.6M to 5.7M over one year, supported by Arlo Secure and Total Security offerings.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in the paying customer base, driving ARR.

kpis.name: Cumulative Registered Accounts
kpis.explanation: Total number of unique accounts on the Arlo platform.
kpis.description: The Arlo community reached 12.1 million accounts, providing a pool for future monetization.
kpis.signal: Expanding user base, a source of future conversion.

kpis.name: Annual Recurring Revenue
kpis.explanation: Expected annual revenue from paid subscriptions.
kpis.description: ARR is growing strongly, reflecting the company's strategy to monetize its existing customer base.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in the SaaS model.

kpis.name: Subscriptions and Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from subscriptions and cloud services.
kpis.description: Service revenues now exceed product revenues, signaling a successful business transformation.
kpis.signal: Successful transition to a recurring revenue model.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin improved significantly, supported by the rise of high-margin services.
kpis.signal: Structural improvement driven by service mix.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is vulnerable to cyberattacks due to the nature of its operations and the sensitive data it hosts. A security breach could have severe consequences on its reputation and operations. The report emphasizes cybersecurity importance with dedicated governance.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in an increasingly competitive market with major industry players. This could impact its market share, margins, and revenues. The report highlights the need to continue innovating to remain competitive.

risks.title: Geopolitical and Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: Trade tensions and changes in tariff policies create uncertainty. The report explicitly mentions potential impacts of tariffs on the supply chain and future margins.

risks.title: Supplier Dependency and Supply Chain
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on suppliers for critical components and manufactured products. Supply chain disruptions, changes in availability, or reduced supplier exposure to US markets could delay deliveries.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company may face litigation related to intellectual property, regulatory compliance, or other business areas. Financial impact has been limited to date.

ai_positioning.summary: Arlo explicitly integrates artificial intelligence and machine learning as core competencies. The company emphasizes its expertise in AI and computer vision analytics to deliver intelligent, personalized security services. AI is positioned as a key component of its cloud platform and differentiating value proposition.
evidence: Arlo's deep expertise in cloud services, cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision analytics
delivers seamless, smart home security for Arlo users
